name: Emo Tiao Jiu Shi
source:
Mix drinks and mingle with monster girls! Manage a bar staffed by cute waitresses and work hard to earn their affection! Take orders, make sophisticated small-talk and get lucky in the wildest ways possible...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1854250/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
调制饮料，与怪物女孩们交朋友！经营一家由可爱女服务生工作的酒吧，努力赢得她们的好感！接待客人、进行老练的闲聊，还能以最狂野的方式撞上好运……

[来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1854250/]Steam[/url]]
